value.name: Daniel apologizes for past rejection
value.description: Daniel apologizes to Rosa for telling her as a teenager that she was not part of the family.
evidence: "Rosa," he said. "I want to apologize for three specific things, in order of how long ago they happened. The first is that when I was sixteen I told you, in the kitchen, that you were not part of the family. I have remembered saying that for twenty-six years and I have never apologized for it and I am apologizing for it now."

value.name: Daniel apologizes for failing to appreciate Rosa's care
value.description: Daniel apologizes for assuming Rosa was adequately paid and for never thanking or helping her while his mother was sick.
evidence: "The second is that when my mother was sick, in the last six months, I assumed that you were being paid enough to do what you were doing and I did not, on any of my visits, thank you for what you were doing or ask whether you needed help doing it. I am apologizing for that."

value.name: Daniel apologizes for speaking about Rosa in her presence
value.description: Daniel apologizes for talking about Rosa as if she were not in the room before reading the document on Thursday.
evidence: "The third is that on Thursday, in the dining room, before I read the document, I spoke about you as if you were not in the room. I am apologizing for that."

value.name: Rosa accepts Daniel's apologies
value.description: Rosa tells Daniel that she accepts his apologies and singles out the first one as especially important to her.
evidence: "Daniel," she said. "I accept the apologies. The first one in particular I have been waiting for, and I am glad to have it, and I will not pretend I am not."

value.name: Rosa offers to discuss the second apology
value.description: Rosa says the second apology is more complicated and invites Daniel to talk about it if he wants.
evidence: "The second one is more complicated and we can talk about it if you want."

value.name: Rosa says she had already forgiven the third apology
value.description: Rosa explains that she had already forgiven Daniel's third offense in her mind because she saw him forgive himself later that afternoon.
evidence: "The third one I had already, in my head, forgiven, because I watched you forgive yourself for it later in the same afternoon, and watching that was, in its way, enough."

value.name: Daniel thanks Rosa
value.description: Daniel responds to Rosa's acceptance with gratitude.

value.name: Rosa asks the question
value.description: Rosa prompts Daniel to ask what he wants to know next.

value.name: Daniel begins asking whether she knew
value.description: Daniel starts to ask Rosa whether his mother knew how he behaved with her in her final years.
